items.summary: CTO review: approve containment-only execution. Deferred opportunities remain technically feasible but are not queue-ready. Continue only existing repair-or-close, isolated deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, measurement, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work using existing recorded telemetry. Do not create or requeue production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spending, monetization changes, or external outreach. Preserve private launch gates, parked dispositions, and unknown financial or causal outcomes.

Existing failures may proceed only through their current repair-or-close work items. Before any requeue or release, document ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, deduplication, and an available measurement boundary. Do not create duplicate work or request telemetry already present in the authoritative snapshot.
